notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground, two strips, Harshang pattern, 18th century, Khanates Period, possibly Karabagh, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1915. inv. no 35 (3964) from the Mosque of Murad Pasha, Erzurum, Turkey. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 84.
